mapper.select: select student_code as studentCode, user_id as userId, student_id as studentId, college_dept_id as collegeId from talk_student_account where user_id = #{userId}
select student_code as studentCode, user_id as userId, student_id as studentId, college_dept_id as collegeId from talk_student_account where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: update talk_student_account set student_code = #{studentCode}, college_dept_id = #{collegeId} where user_id = #{userId} and student_id = #{studentId}

update sys_user u join talk_student_account a on a.user_id = u.user_id set u.user_name = #{studentCode}, u.update_time = now() where u.user_id = #{userId} and a.student_id = #{studentId} and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into talk_student_account (student_code, user_id, student_id, college_dept_id) values (#{studentCode}, #{userId}, #{studentId}, #{collegeId})

insert ignore into talk_class_manager (class_dept_id, teacher_id, create_time) select d.dept_id, t.teacher_id, now() from talk_teacher t join talk_teacher_class tc on tc.teacher_code = t.teacher_code join sys_dept d on d.dept_name = tc.class_name and d.dept_type = 'class' and d.del_flag = '0' where t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and find_in_set(t.dept_id, d.ancestors) and (select count(*) from sys_dept named_class where named_class.dept_name = tc.class_name and named_class.dept_type = 'class' and named_class.del_flag = '0' and (named_class.dept_id = t.dept_id or find_in_set(t.dept_id, named_class.ancestors))) = 1 and not exists (select 1 from talk_class_manager cm join sys_dept precise on precise.dept_id = cm.class_dept_id where cm.teacher_id = t.teacher_id and precise.dept_name = tc.class_name)
mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from talk_class_manager where class_dept_id = #{classDeptId} and teacher_id = #{teacherId})
mapper.insert: insert ignore into talk_student_manager (student_id, teacher_id, create_time) values (#{studentId}, #{teacherId}, now())
insert ignore into talk_class_manager (class_dept_id, teacher_id, create_time) values (#{classDeptId}, #{teacherId}, now())
insert ignore into talk_teacher_class (teacher_code, class_name, create_time) values (#{teacherCode}, #{className}, now())
mapper.select: select distinct t.teacher_id as teacherId, t.teacher_code as teacherCode, t.teacher_name as teacherName, t.dept_id as deptId, t.position, t.user_id as userId, t.status from talk_student s join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id join talk_teacher t on (t.dept_id = d.dept_id or find_in_set(t.dept_id, d.ancestors)) where s.student_id = #{studentId} and (exists (select 1 from talk_class_manager cm where cm.class_dept_id = s.dept_id and cm.teacher_id = t.teacher_id) or (exists (select 1 from talk_teacher_class tc where tc.teacher_code = t.teacher_code and tc.class_name = d.dept_name) and (select count(*) from sys_dept named_class where named_class.dept_name = d.dept_name and named_class.dept_type = 'class' and named_class.del_flag = '0' and (named_class.dept_id = t.dept_id or find_in_set(t.dept_id, named_class.ancestors))) = 1 and not exists (select 1 from talk_class_manager precise join sys_dept bound_class on bound_class.dept_id = precise.class_dept_id where precise.teacher_id = t.teacher_id and bound_class.dept_name = d.dept_name))) order by t.teacher_code
